title: Truesilver Deposit
wikitext:
[[File:Truesilver Deposit.png|thumb|Truesilver Deposit]]

'''Truesilver Deposits''' rarely spawn in place of [[Mithril Deposit]]s or [[Small Thorium Vein]]s; as a result, they can be found in any zone where mithril or thorium is found.
